theme: Picking a join order with unreliable statistics
title: Chain-Join Plans Under Uncertain Cardinality Estimates
innovation_hook: Choosing the cheapest plan under estimated cardinalities is optimal when estimates are right and catastrophic when they are wrong, and the score uses TRUE cardinalities; the strong strategy selects a robust plan whose worst case across the estimate's uncertainty range is bounded, and further hedges by using a reoptimization checkpoint to pick a different continuation per observed bucket.
strategies: trivial: canonical always-extend-right order, same continuation for every bucket (reproduces the checker's own baseline construction)

greedy: full enumeration of join orders using the point-estimate selectivities only, no uncertainty hedge, same continuation for every bucket -- optimal when estimates are right, catastrophic on the planted 100x-mis-estimated edges
strong: minimax-robust prefix selection (worst case over the certified uncertainty box) plus a genuine per-bucket contingency continuation chosen at the reoptimization checkpoint
invalid: plan requests moves past the end of the chain -> rejected infeasible
